scope: Primary-source audit for additional exclusions and sieve ancestry; not exhaustive novelty certification

sources.author: Yasushi Ieno
sources.title: Other special cases of a square problem
sources.use: Th6 is the predecessor of the low-mate argument; original opposite odd legs are products of two distinct bad primes. General exponent count and whole-plane argument are separately proved in low_mate_exclusion.md.
sources.caveat: Preprint. Th5 uses positive complementary legs; do not transfer to all-plane without additional proof. No claim the present corollary is new.

sources.author: William McCloskey
sources.title: A Congruence Condition For The Four-Distance Problem
sources.use: Explicit modular lifting via Jacobian; 3-adic restriction; exclusion of one octic family.
sources.caveat: 3^100 is a modulus with local solutions, not a denominator exclusion frontier. Does not exclude all sextic or octic families.

sources.author: Jonathan Love
sources.title: Rational configuration problems and a family of curves
sources.use: Local obstructions for a genus-one family and density bound in a four-coefficient integer box.
sources.caveat: The coefficient-box density is not automatically a density statement for (n,u,v) square-search parameters.

sources.title: Constructing 7-clusters
sources.use: Primary computational precedent for Boolean square-residue tables and successive composite-modulus square tests.
sources.caveat: Different geometric problem; not an all-plane unit-square denominator bound. The paper's exact coordinates/distance formulas contain rendering or sign issues, so only the clearly stated modular-test method is imported.

sources.author: T. G. Berry
sources.title: Points at rational distance from the corners of a unit square
sources.use: Known low-degree-family exclusion; sextic-derived genus-five example remains uncompleted in that paper.
sources.caveat: No assertion about current full solution of that exact genus-five curve. Exact equations were not recovered from visual PDF during this audit.

sources.author: Y. Ji
sources.title: Several special cases of a square problem
sources.use: Midline exclusion, with stated extension outside the square.
sources.caveat: Preprint; other special cases not automatically imported.

sources.title: Rational distances from given rational points in the plane
sources.use: 2025 peer-reviewed source on three-distance density and general-type distance surfaces.
sources.caveat: No effective unit-square denominator bound or unconditional emptiness conclusion.

novelty_status.low_mate_formula: Elementary corollary/generalization of known factor-pair arguments; same exact statement not found in inspected sources; novelty unconfirmed
novelty_status.unit_n_prime_square_projection_tables: Specific tables not found in inspected sources; modular lifting and modular sieves are established methods
novelty_status.critical_mod_1681_table: Specific residue list not found in inspected sources; Hensel lifting itself is established

non_adopted_claim.status: A 2026 complete-solution claim was found but is not used. The proof has not been independently validated.

root_citation_note: The parent/root agent must independently open or search each source before citing child-owned web references in the user-facing answer.
